Diagram: small table before → small table after, with a plain-language line below

Source: R/guide.R
kit_diagram.Rd

Goes in the diagram of kit_tab_guide(). On narrow screens (≤ 576px) "before" is on top, the arrow points down, and "after" is below. Each small table has 2–3 rows and uses generic names (id, score, wave), not column names from a particular database.

Usage

kit_diagram(before, after, caption, arrow = "→")

Arguments

before

The small table(s) before: one kit_dg_table() or a list of them (side by side).

after

The small table after: one kit_dg_table().

caption

One plain-language line (<figcaption>).

arrow

The arrow in the middle.

Value

<figure class="kit-diagram">.

Examples

kit_diagram(
  list(kit_dg_table(data.frame(id = 1:2, t1 = c(3, 5)), "第 1 波"),
       kit_dg_table(data.frame(id = c(1, 3), t2 = c(4, 6)), "第 2 波")),
  kit_dg_table(data.frame(id = 1:3, t1 = c(3, 5, NA), t2 = c(4, NA, 6)), "結果"),
  "依 id 接起來：沒有出席的那一波是空的。"
)
